title: Sean McVay won't play 'victim card' after questionable pass interference call in Rams loss to Broncos: 'It is what it is'

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Sean McVay won't play 'victim card' after questionable pass interference call in Rams loss to Broncos: 'It is what it is'
sources.description: The Broncos rallied late, and survived a near-interception after a controversial pass interference call, to beat the Rams on Sunday night.
